cohort: The study included 25 HIV-infected pregnant women treated with atazanavir/ritonavir plus either tenofovir/emtricitabine or abacavir/lamivudine.
finding: Intracellular atazanavir exposure remains unchanged during pregnancy, supporting the standard 300/100mg atazanavir/ritonavir dosing throughout pregnancy.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken during the first, second, and third trimesters, and post-partum.
